domain_and_universes: R is an arbitrary implicit Type u with a unital CommRing instance. Ideals and their natural-number-indexed OrderHom chains live in the elaborated universe shown above. No Nontrivial, domain, field, characteristic, countability, or finiteness-of-carrier premise is present.
ordered_binders: finite-generation premise for every I : Ideal R
hypotheses: R has a unital commutative ring structure
every ideal of R is finitely generated
f is monotone under ideal inclusion by its OrderHom type
conclusion: There exists n such that f n = f m for every natural m at least n.
minimal_import_basis: Finiteness.Defs defines Submodule.FG and supplies the ideal/order interfaces needed by the exact target and checked statement transports. Deleting it, or replacing it with the smaller Ideal.Defs import, fails. No Noetherian-definition or ascending-chain proof module is imported.

checked_alternate_encodings.boundary: Records that Ideal R is definitionally the regular submodule Submodule R R in the pinned environment.
Exposes an ascending sequence as a function Nat -> Ideal R plus an explicit Monotone hypothesis.

uncredited_alternate_encodings: the converse implication from stabilization to finite generation
historically nonunital and noncommutative left/right variants

included: the zero ring and all subsingleton commutative rings
chains constant from index zero and chains with repeated ideals
fields, domains, finite rings, and PIDs only as special cases
checked_witnesses: Stage1_Instances/THM-M-0028/BoundaryProbe.lean (PUnit CommRing, ideal finite generation, and 0 = 1 checks)
